max_interest_rate_pa.notes: Default simple interest on overdue levies: 10% per annum.

max_interest_rate_pa_by_special_resoluti.notes: Maximum interest rate by special resolution: 20% per annum.

interest_grace_period_days.notes: No statutory grace period — interest accrues from the day levy falls due.

can_transfer_between_funds.notes: Admin-to-sinking fund transfers permitted by ordinary resolution.

inter_fund_transfer_resolution_required.notes: Ordinary resolution sufficient for admin→sinking transfer. Allowed values: none, ordinary, general_meeting, special, prohibited.

overbudget_threshold_pct.notes: ACT has no statutory over-budget cap requiring approval. Returns null.

overbudget_requires_resolution_above_pct.notes: No statutory trigger for over-budget resolution in ACT.

trust_withdrawal_authority_roles.notes: Assistant property agents cannot authorise trust withdrawals per s.107A. Only licensed principal or strata manager may authorise.

trial_balance_deadline_days.notes: Quarterly statement due within 15 business days after quarter-end.

audit_deadline.notes: Audit of trust records must be completed by 30 September each year.

pooled_trust_permitted.notes: Pooled trust accounts are permitted under the Agents Act 2003 Part 7.

interest_belongs_to.notes: Interest on pooled trust accounts accrues to the scheme (owners corporation). Allowed values: scheme, statutory_account, body_corporate.

committee_spending_cap_formula.notes: ACT has no statutory committee spending cap formula.

min_withholding_pct_no_abn.notes: ATO PAYG withholding: 47% on payments to suppliers without ABN. Applies uniformly in all jurisdictions.

agm_notice_days.notes: AGM notice must be received at least 14 days before meeting.

agm_notice_days_unopposed_resolution.notes: 21 days when an unopposed/unanimous resolution is to be moved.

ec_meeting_notice_days.notes: Minimum 7 days notice for executive committee meetings.

minutes_distribution_days.notes: Minutes must be provided to each member within 14 days after meeting.

agm_max_gap_months.notes: AGM must be held within 15 months of the previous AGM.

levy_interest_rate_default_percent.notes: Default simple interest on unpaid levies: 10% per annum.

levy_interest_rate_max_percent.notes: Max interest rate up to 20% by special resolution.

levy_interest_rate_min_percent.notes: OC may set less than 10% by special resolution.

audit_threshold_budget_aud.notes: Mandatory audit if annual budget exceeds $250,000.

audit_threshold_lots.notes: Mandatory audit if scheme has more than 100 lots.

financial_statements_deadline_months.notes: Annual financial statements must be presented at AGM within 3 months of year-end.

sinking_fund_review_years.notes: Sinking fund plan must be reviewed every 5 years.

record_retention_years.notes: Books and records must be kept for at least 7 years.

record_inspection_days.notes: Records must be available for inspection within 14 days of request.

public_liability_minimum_aud.notes: Minimum $10M public liability insurance for common property.

building_insurance_required.notes: Building insurance at replacement value — mandatory.

rental_certificate_validity_years.notes: Rental certificate valid for 5 years from issue date.

rental_certificate_response_days.notes: Owners corporation must respond to rental cert request within 14 business days.

manager_contract_max_years.notes: Strata management contracts may not exceed 3 years.

voting_records_retention_days.notes: Voting records retained for at least 28 days.

egm_petition_threshold_percent.notes: Owners holding 25%+ of unit entitlements can requisition an EGM.

capital_funding_standard_notice_days.notes: No verified generic capital-funding levy payment period is encoded. Capital funding approval must pass through meeting notice controls; due dates and contribution terms must be set in the approved resolution and notice.

capital_funding_emergency_notice_days.notes: No shorter generic emergency levy period is encoded; urgent works still require jurisdiction-specific legal review.

capital_funding_notice_period_verified.notes: Payment-period validation must rely on legal-review evidence and approved motion text, not a generic platform default.

capital_funding_resolution_required.notes: Special-purpose funds may be established by special resolution; contribution and expenditure rules must align with the approved fund and sinking-fund plan.

capital_funding_allocation_basis.notes: Administrative and sinking fund contributions are ordinarily proportionate to unit entitlement unless the Act and approved resolution permit another method.

capital_funding_benefit_principle_availa.notes: No generic benefit-principle allocator is enabled; class-based allocations require scheme-specific legal review.

capital_funding_tenant_consultation_requ.notes: Tenant consultation is not a default levy-approval condition; rental-certificate and works-access obligations are separate workflows.

capital_funding_hardship_notice_required.notes: No ACT-specific hardship notice requirement is encoded; hardship support can still be offered as product policy.

capital_funding_hybrid_legal_review_requ.notes: Hybrid owner-funded and loan-funded structures require recorded legal approval before notices or credits are issued.
